# DocUI v1.2.1 update validation

Updated DocGen from v1.1.0 to the published stable v1.2.1 release. The tag resolves to `8a9032c7546db6dd9c55e38f15e6c9e388987fab`.

## Changed files

All paths below are relative to `packages/docgen-php/`.

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `resources/docgen/document-design-v1.2.1.css` | Add exact upstream compiled CSS, without editing or rebuilding it. |
| `resources/docgen/document-design-LICENSE.txt` | Update release, source, immutable URLs and checksums; retain archive provenance and verbatim MIT notice. |
| `resources/docgen/style.css` | Update the integration version comment; retain compatible DocGen extensions. |
| `src/DocGen/Render/AssetPublisher.php` | Publish the new stylesheet without touching older versioned files. |
| `src/DocGen/Render/PageChrome.php` | Reference v1.2.1 through the existing relative path calculation. |
| `docs/docgen.md` | Document v1.2.1, compatibility review, archive preservation and cache refresh. |
| `tests/Unit/DocGen/Render/AssetPublisherTest.php` | Check new bytes/provenance/license and preserve both archived versions, including their timestamps. |
| `tests/Unit/DocGen/Render/PageChromeTest.php` | Update root and nested HTML stylesheet expectations. |

## Upstream verification

Downloaded CSS, LICENSE and DESIGN.md from `https://k-kinzal.github.io/document-design/v1.2.1/`. Their contents match the files in the release ZIP. The ZIP matches upstream's attached SHA256SUMS. Existing DocGen catalog markup requires no migration. Every upstream token referenced by DocGen's extensions still exists. No optional upstream scripts, palette controls or new product features were introduced.

## Checks

Environment: PHP 8.5.8, PHPUnit 13.4.0, macOS, headless Chrome 154.0.8037.98.

- `composer test`: **passed**, 1,196 tests and 3,447 assertions. The archive data-provider name was subsequently aligned with the repository naming rule; the affected AssetPublisher tests were rerun successfully.
- `composer format:check`: **passed**.
- `composer phpstan`: **passed** after aligning the test data provider with repository rules.
- `composer compat`: **passed**.
- `composer guard`: **passed**.
- `composer deptrac`: **passed**, no violations, errors or warnings.
- `git diff --check`: **passed**.
- `composer lint`: **blocked at autoload:check** by an existing ambiguous vendor `Stringable` class in `symfony/polyfill-php80/Resources/stubs/Stringable.php` and `marc-mabe/php-enum/stubs/Stringable.php`. Dependencies and Composer configuration were not changed. All remaining lint gates were run individually as listed above.

## Real generation and offline checks

Generated the package's real documentation with:

```sh
sandbox-exec -p '(version 1)(allow default)(deny network*)' \
  php packages/docgen-php/bin/docgen \
  --packages=packages/docgen-php --exclude='*/tests/Fixture/*' \
  --output=build/docui-v1.2.1 --no-cache --jobs=4
```

This generated 546 pages with network access denied. Also generated 546 real revision-diff pages for `19ec1756..e7080d84` and a seven-page supplementary Japanese PHPDoc/Markdown fixture. All 1,099 pages reference v1.2.1 and have resolving relative stylesheets. A separate all-package generation produced 2,287 pages in `build/docui-v1.2.1-all-packages`.

The representative real output is `build/docui-v1.2.1/index.html`. The diff output is `build/docui-v1.2.1-diff/index.html`; the Japanese fixture is `build/docui-v1.2.1-qa/site/index.html`.

`verify.cjs` in this directory runs the browser checks. `browser-results.json` records their successful result. The Browser plugin had no available connection, so these checks used a separate headless Chrome instance.

- Opened root and deeply nested pages through `file://` with the browser offline.
- Verified search navigation, relative links, theme switching and persistence after reload.
- Verified Japanese prose, parameter tables and code; copied Japanese example text and the run command using the actual clipboard controls.
- Verified 390px mobile layout, navigation open/close, search positioning and readability without JavaScript.
- Verified real revision diff controls and removed-source-line visibility in inline/off/changes modes.
- Recorded zero external requests, failed requests or JavaScript errors.
- Generated A4 and Letter PDFs from an explicit dark theme; confirmed light print colors and hidden navigation/search/copy controls.
- Visually inspected desktop, mobile, dark theme, source diff and PDF renderings. Japanese glyphs remain readable; text is not clipped or overlapping.
- The real DocGen guide prints as 14 A4 pages and 15 Letter pages; the Japanese sample prints as one page in either format. Text extraction and bounding-box checks found no blank pages, replacement characters or text outside the paper bounds.

PDFs and screenshots are retained here as local QA artifacts. Browser and print testing was performed on macOS Chrome, not the full upstream browser/platform matrix. The vendor autoload ambiguity above is the only failing project check encountered that remains unresolved.
